characters.identity: A woman who builds a home and becomes its quiet strength, the keeper of its memory and its love.
characters.psychological_depth: Patient, enduring, quietly strong; the memory and heart of the family.

characters.identity: The man she marries, who grows old beside her, learning through the years what her love has meant.
characters.psychological_depth: Steady, sometimes distant, slowly awakened to the depth of her love.

characters.identity: The sons and daughters who grow in her care and carry her memory into the world.
characters.psychological_depth: Shaped by her love, carrying her memory forward.

characters.identity: The parents and relatives who arrange the marriage and pass down the traditions of the home.
characters.psychological_depth: Guardians of tradition, the bridge between generations.
